import pathlib, json, hashlib, itertools
from PIL import Image, ImageChops

t=pathlib.Path('/private/tmp/skey-visual-differences')
rows=json.loads((t/'captures-results.json').read_text())
old=json.loads(pathlib.Path('docs/superpowers/reports/2026-10-17-visual-qa-batch3-evidence.json').read_text())
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def compare(a,b):
    assert a.size==b.size
    d=ImageChops.difference(a,b)
    values=list(d.get_flattened_data())
    xy=[(i%a.width,i//a.width) for i,v in enumerate(values) if v!=(0,0,0)]
    return {'pixels':len(xy),'bounds':d.getbbox(),'maxChannelDelta':max((max(v) for v in values),default=0)},xy

results=[];points={}
for project,name in dict.fromkeys((r['project'],r['name']) for r in rows):
    rs=sorted([r for r in rows if (r['project'],r['name'])==(project,name)],key=lambda r:r['repeat'])
    assert len(rs)==3 and all(r['status']=='passed' for r in rs)
    baseline=Image.open(rs[0]['baseline']).convert('RGB'); ims=[Image.open(r['destination']).convert('RGB') for r in rs]
    cs=[];union=set()
    for i,im in enumerate(ims):
        c,xy=compare(baseline,im);union.update(xy);cs.append({'repeat':i+1,**c})
    ps=[]
    for i,j in itertools.combinations(range(3),2):
        c,xy=compare(ims[i],ims[j]);union.update(xy);ps.append({'a':i+1,'b':j+1,**c})
    variable=any(p['pixels'] for p in ps)
    classification='variable across identical-build captures' if variable else 'reproducible mismatch' if cs[0]['pixels'] else 'no longer reproducible'
    prior=next(x for x in old['investigationOutcomes'] if (x['project'],x['name'])==(project,name))
    cross=[]
    for i,im in enumerate(ims):
        for j in range(3):
            p=pathlib.Path('docs/superpowers/reports/2026-10-17-visual-qa-batch3-assets/investigation')/project/(str(j+1)+'-'+name.removesuffix('.png')+'.webp')
            c,_=compare(Image.open(p).convert('RGB'),im);cross.append({'currentRepeat':i+1,'earlierRepeat':j+1,**c})
    # Read-only DOM probes use the union of all changed pixels, not a relaxed comparison.
    points[project+'/'+name]=[{'x':x,'y':y} for x,y in sorted(union)]
    envs=[r['environment'] for r in rs]
    result={'project':project,'name':name,'baseline':rs[0]['baseline'],'baselineSha256':sha(rs[0]['baseline']),'baselineComparisons':cs,'withinBuild':ps,'classification':classification,'cause':'unexplained','earlier':prior,'currentVsEarlierCaptures':cross,'recordedGeometryStable':all({k:rs[0][k] for k in ['rect','clip','scrolls']}=={k:r[k] for k in ['rect','clip','scrolls']} for r in rs),'recordedEnvironmentStable':all(env==envs[0] for env in envs),'changedPixelUnionSize':len(union)}
    results.append(result)
    print(project+'/'+name,[c['pixels'] for c in cs],[c['pixels'] for c in ps],classification,'stable env',result['recordedEnvironmentStable'])
(t/'analysis.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
(t/'probe-points.json').write_text(json.dumps(points)+'\n')
